name: Let Lie.
source:
Arron and Mal are in the middle of their five year relationship when Arron notices Mal, his robot boyfriend, start to act strangely.

[From [url=https://sometotalloser.itch.io/let-lie]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
艾倫和馬爾交往已有五年。就在這段感情中，艾倫察覺自己的機器人男友馬爾近來開始有了奇怪的舉動。

［摘自[url=https://sometotalloser.itch.io/let-lie]Itch.io[/url]］
